claims.title: Retained path
claims.assessment: Named CalcMain wrapper reads two input words and calls 0x1047bd790 at embedded state +0x48. Exact retained call/store instruction fields establish the call target and storing S0/S1 into adjacent output slots. This resolves the decompiled second-register omission for this boundary only, not the full host invocation or processing law.

claims.title: Conditional private coefficient trace
claims.assessment: Left/Right named wrappers reach distinct setters writing raw 0x3f800000 or 0xbf800000 to adjacent state words. Kernel text multiplies each input by those state words before later processing. This is a conditional internal coefficient trace, not a complete phase/UI/combined-control signal law.

claims.title: Conditional mute trace
claims.assessment: Named Mute wrapper reaches the byte setter +0xcf on its non-Legacy branch. Exact kernel instruction words load that byte, zero D0/D1, and branch on bit0 directly to RET. This is narrowly conditional two-register zero-return evidence. The application UI/storage message route, full state/active callback invocation and independent review remain necessary before any application grade or accepted law.

claims.title: Control-state dependencies
claims.assessment: Width/MidSide, Mono, Balance and Gain handlers reach coefficient helpers, four of which contain eight unresolved computed-call sites. Constructor text assigns callback functions, but their recovered signatures/output pairs are incomplete. No pan/width/gain/ramp law is adopted.

claims.title: Rate/filter/reset dependencies
claims.assessment: Rate/cutoff setters and kernel text expose stateful arithmetic, reset writes, BassMono/Audition/DC flags and polynomial coefficient expressions. No filter identity, order, response, cutoff/tolerance or sample/block timing is inferred without ABI and state evidence.

claims.title: Initialization data frontier
claims.assessment: Exact authorized retained-image reads recover initializer bytes at 0x10584cbc0 (float32 1,0,0,0), 0x1054e91a8 (u64 1), and 0x1059cd280 (two float32 values1.414211392402649/4.84096496222719e-08). Pointer targets show initially zero file-backed Unity storage/guard. These are literal file bytes, NOT initialized runtime expected state; guard execution, callback output/signatures and packed/ramp semantics remain unproved.

claims.title: Legacy and scheduling frontier
claims.assessment: Named LegacyMode writes the branch flag at +0x162; Init/selection text chooses distinct callback pointers. Literal slot0x106541200 contains0x1021658b0, binding this selected callback pointer to the named wrapper. Nine Legacy calculation bodies remain metadata-only; runtime activation and other callback/migration paths remain unproved. Modern and Legacy are not interchangeable.

claims.title: Factory boundary

Exact thunk binding, upstream Utility UI/storage dispatch and scheduler lifecycle have not been completed. No constructor/default or arbitrary-object safety claim.
